limits: No CodeQL CLI rescan was performed locally. Hosted results must establish which diagnostics remain; dispositions do not suppress or rewrite queries.

Retained intentional Protocol, pytest.raises, await and descriptor-ownership constructs may still be emitted by CodeQL. A security owner can review these concrete dispositions; no unsafe code edit is required merely to change query output.
Fault tests cover normal close behavior, each os.open interruption and fstat failures. They do not simulate os.close itself failing, process death or MemoryError between acquisition and registration.

Initial selected test runs without --no-cov passed66 and33 tests but failed repository whole-suite85percent coverage threshold (18.76percent and18.61percent). Selected runs here use --no-cov; full-suite coverage remains a separate root qualification gate.
No new lint or CodeQL suppression added. Cold-import regression uses multiprocessing spawn with timeout/termination and pipe cleanup.

Private auto_instrument aliases retain initial object identity and callable signatures. Rebinding private module globals no longer propagates to the shared helper/coverage registry; repository callers do not depend on such rebinding. No full private monkeypatch-compatibility claim.
